verdict.rationale: llamafile's server bundles llama.cpp's Web UI. Users chat with the local model by opening http://localhost:8080 in a browser, and the CLI reference lists Web UI options. A community user praises the 'web server with chat' UX. missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the chat UI's features (history, settings, multimodal use in the GUI), hands-on detail beyond a brief community mention.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can chat with local models using a built-in graphical chat interface

citations.quote: you can also chat with it using [llama.cpp](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp)'s Web UI: just open a browser window and connect to http://localhost:8080/
HTTP server, API, Web UI, slot, and server sandbox options.
The llamafile UX (CLI interface and web server with chat) is great
